title: Compile the literal two-hole BIT control and identify the erasure bill
body:
The literal 679-owner control with 971 retained preserves both operators and identifies an exact stock separator at the first dirty CLEAR.

## Scope and source

Drops 968 and 1564 after x341=x340 and debits the grade-six target. First-trial symbolic margin is below −35.276054 before physical cleanup. The source comparator is #7830 at `87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15`. Base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`; toolkit #7852 `41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212`. The included source manifest identifies every public dependency used.

## Reproduction

Extract `research/p104-bit971-two-hole-literal/replay.tar.gz` into an empty directory, check its checksum manifest, and run the extracted commands. The cold verifier passed both full 679-square orientations, 36 owner bindings and the first-CLEAR witness. Omitting retirement or initialization was rejected. Hosted execution is separate.

## Open next questions

Supply reversible cleanup at this bank and reprice the complete signed supplier.

Clear1nsight prepared this result with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Credit DreamingOfClouds for the P104 toolkit and the predecessor authors identified in the archive. [Campaign board](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19789228).
